recommendation: Keep the fix as-is; it completes the published Pharmacy decision on the refactored MedicationKnowledge path. Handle any future MedicationRequest or FormularyItem alignment through separate Jira-scoped work.
issue_request: FHIR-30092 requested MedicationKnowledge administrationGuideline treatment intent support: add treatmentIntent 0..1 CodeableConcept, require indication when treatmentIntent is present, and bind by example to children of SNOMED CT 262202000 Therapeutic Intents. Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution, applied for R5.
initial_application: The grouped 2021 MedicationKnowledge commit 1683ac64141af807564d62a28932d70133142fb3 added treatmentIntent while applying related refactoring, but current source and R5 publication showed no treatmentIntent binding and no indication constraint.
additional_context: FHIR-30093/FHIR-28597 moved the original administrationGuideline semantics to indicationGuideline/dosingGuideline, so the correct modern target is MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.dosingGuideline.treatmentIntent. January 2021 Pharmacy WGM minutes confirm the constraint and 262202000 example value set. FHIR-33219 is later background only and does not reverse this MedicationKnowledge requirement.
reconciliation: Added invariant mkn-1 to MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline, added condition references to indication and dosingGuideline.treatmentIntent, and added an example binding on treatmentIntent to http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs=isa/262202000 in the active core StructureDefinition.
source_changes: source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml: added mkn-1 invariant requiring indication when dosingGuideline.treatmentIntent exists.
source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml: added mkn-1 condition references to indication and treatmentIntent.

related_jiras.note: Explains the indicationGuideline/dosingGuideline refactor that changes the target path for the FHIR-30092 requirement.
Cited by FHIR-30093 as the decision that inverted the MedicationKnowledge indication/administrationGuideline model.
